age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

asset_scale.description: Decimal places of the display values: base units / 10^asset_scale

can_clawback.description: The issuer can claw back holdings

can_escrow.description: Holdings can be placed in escrow

can_transfer.description: Holders can transfer to each other

locked.description: Every holding is locked: holders cannot transfer

locked_amount.description: Base units locked in escrow; null when none

locked_amount_display.description: locked_amount / 10^asset_scale; null when locked_amount is null

maximum_amount.description: Maximum supply in base units; null when the issuance sets none (the ledger limit 9223372036854775807 applies)

maximum_amount_display.description: maximum_amount / 10^asset_scale; null when maximum_amount is null

metadata_present.description: True when the issuer set metadata; the content is not served

outstanding_amount.description: Supply held by holders, in base units

transfer_fee_pct.description: Fee the issuer charges on transfers between holders, in percent (TransferFee / 1000)

transferable.description: True when can_transfer is set and the issuance is not locked

utilization.description: outstanding_amount / maximum_amount; null without a maximum

description: MPT issuance: issuer, supply, scale, transfer fee and flags. When to use: Before accepting or sending an MPT: to check its issuer, decimal scale, supply against its maximum, transfer fee, and whether it can be transferred, locked, escrowed or clawed back. Prefer another tool: To check whether one MPT payment between two accounts can succeed now (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness` with the issuance id as `asset`), or for a trust-line token written `CODE.issuer` (use `/v1/xrpl/token/{asset}`). Example: xrpl_mpt {"mpt_issuance_id":"05FA6AB8561E39FA605779B829BB5974E82B40AF173D6AF3"} Credits only: paid by prepaid credit, 0.0025 EUR or 0.003 USD units per call; buy a bundle first at https://api.criptonlabs.com/v1/pro/credits/{bundle} or with `credits_topup`, then call with the `clc_` token or Sign-In-With-X.

mpt_issuance_id.description: MPT issuance id: 48 hexadecimal characters, either case
